fields.title: 📖 The greatest gift in Paradise
fields.body:
🖋️ **al-Ājurrī** narrated from **Ṣuhayb** that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

> ***“When the people of Paradise enter Paradise, it will be called out to them: O people of Paradise, you have an appointment with Allah which you have not yet seen.”***

Then the veil is lifted, and they look upon Allah. The Prophet ﷺ mentioned that Allah has given them nothing more beloved to them than this, and he recited: **“For those who did good is the best – and still more.”**

🌙 **Conclusion:** The highest gift in Paradise is not only salvation from the Fire and entry into the gardens, but the **sight of Allah**. Ahlus-Sunnah affirms this truth without asking how and without distorting the clear texts.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Ājurrī, ash-Sharīʿah, Kitāb at-taṣdīq bi-n-naẓar ilā Allah ʿazza wa-jall, Athar Nr. 602, Bd. 3, S. 1010–1011.
